definition.missing_outcome_policy: If a selected security has no valid next-calendar-month adjusted close, fail that month/run; do not replace with rank 21.

historical_diagnostics_at_20bp_cost.selection_note: Do not select this formula using the post-hoc window. All historical results are exploratory.

limitations: Historical results are exploratory: the 925-symbol universe is survivor-oriented and point-in-time SET/mai membership has not been validated.
The current data panel omits known delisted-name price histories; survivorship bias can materially distort all folds.
The 2024-09 to 2025-08 window was evaluated after those dates were observed and is a retrospective diagnostic, not a clean unseen out-of-sample.
The 2025-09 onward window is post-hoc and must not be used to choose a formula.
Factor ranks use only non-null formation-date signal values; selected forward outcomes are checked only after the portfolio is fixed.
A missing selected next-month return invalidates that month; no rank-21 substitution is allowed.
